samples.summary: Second border-writing entry point (`extendBordersAcrossInsertion`) still goes through `setStyle`, bypassing the new prune rule
samples.evidence: `extendBordersAcrossInsertion` writes border keys with `await this.setStyle(insertedRef, patch)` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:1348) and never reaches the new `applyBorderPatch`. It is benign today because the patch it builds only ever contains `true` values (sheet.ts:1341-1346), so no `false` residue can be produced — but the invariant the diff establishes ("cell-level border keys are only ever stored when non-default or needed to override a layer") is enforced in exactly one place and this path is outside it. Same for `applyStylePatchToExistingCells` -> `setStyle(anchor, conflictPatch)` (sheet.ts:1983), which can still write cell-level `bt/bl/br/bb: false`; that one is intentional (conflict override) but is now the only remaining producer of border `false` residue and is untested against the new expectations.

samples.summary: New `store.delete` site can drop spill metadata, because `isEmptyCell`/`compactCell` ignore the spill fields
samples.evidence: `applyBorderPatch` ends with `compactCell(cell, style)` + `isEmptyCell(newCell)` -> `store.delete(anchor)` (sheet.ts:4029-4034). `compactCell` copies only `v`, `f` and `s` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/style-mutation.ts:53-65) and `isEmptyCell` only looks at value/formula/style (style-mutation.ts:44-48), while `Cell` also carries `spillRows`/`spillCols`/`spillAnchor`/`spillBlocked` (packages/sheets/src/model/core/types.ts:213-216). A spill ghost cell written as `{ v: '', spillAnchor: sref }` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/calculator.ts:141) is therefore judged empty and is now DELETED by a border preset, where the old `setStyle` path kept the cell (it stored `bt:false`). The underlying compaction hazard pre-dates this change (setStyle, sheet.ts:3679), but the delete branch is newly reachable for cells that a border preset previously kept alive.

samples.summary: Design doc's border/write-semantics section does not record the new cell-level border pruning contract
samples.evidence: docs/design/sheets/sheet-style.md:56-83 documents the write contracts (`setStyle` preserves explicit `false`; `setRangeStyle` prunes default-only keys) and :111-124 documents `setRangeBorders` as storing per-cell borders, with no mention that border presets now prune default (`false`) keys and may delete a style-only cell. Consumers reading that page will still expect `setRangeBorders` to behave like `setStyle` (explicit `false` preserved), which is exactly what this change stops doing.
